title: Concept: vcpkg manifest without a builtin baseline
description: vcpkg.json declares a manifest that records no `builtin-baseline`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every dependency resolves against the registry's current state, so the same manifest installs different versions over time.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through vcpkg.json (vcpkg).
risk: Every dependency resolves against the registry's current state, so the same manifest installs different versions over time.
